sentences.en: Those present at the concert were surprised by his performance.
sentences.zh: 音乐会现场的人都对他的演出感到惊讶。

sentences.en: She really likes his wild performances on the big stage.
sentences.zh: 她真的喜欢他在大舞台上那些狂野的表演。

sentences.en: Improving corporate performances are behind the stock market recovery.
sentences.zh: 企业业绩的提升是股市复苏的背后原因。

senses.zh: 表演，演出；工作情况，表现；（投资的）业绩
